descriptionChirho: A seal or signet-ring used for authenticating documents and marking ownership. Used of the engraving technique for the priestly breastplate stones (Exod 28:11, 28:21, 28:36, 39:6, 39:14, 39:30), of Judah's personal seal given as pledge to Tamar (Gen 38:18), of sealing as metaphor for secure closure (Job 38:14, 41:15), of Coniah as YHWH's signet (Jer 22:24), and as simile for intimate attachment (Song 8:6 twice; Hag 2:23).
